newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHARES INCH UP IN HIGHER TRADE.
newsitem.headline: SHARES INCH UP IN HIGHER TRADE.

text.p: * Latvian shares inched up a bit at the end of the week in trade of 83,000 lats compared with Thursday's sluggish 39,000 lats.
* The bourse index crept up 0.06 percent to 383.20 while the Rietumu index rose slightly by 0.2 percent to 153.53.
* The official list was mixed, with two of its five stocks holding steady, two rising and one easing.
* Unibanka shares were in relative demand in trade of 42,700 lats at the unchanged price of 3.35 lats.
